title: Mexico Investigates Possible Cartel Links of Prosecutor Who Aided C.I.A.
summary_full: The prosecutor recently fled to the United States after Mexico issued a warrant over his involvement with the C.I.A. Now authorities are investigating him for suspected cartel collusion.
